WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '(no mix recorded)') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '(no mix recorded)')
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    transaction_count,
    1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  s.order_type_mix,
  s.transaction_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - b.average_share AS above_baseline
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE s.share > b.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing ordertypedist value is represented by the label '(no mix recorded)'; an existing value equal to that label is grouped with missing values.
